name: merged-pr-evidence
description: Only the final green merged PR validation supplies shared timing history, preserving late-report and crash recovery.

actions.init: New HTTP boundary and real collector/history
actions.crash: Discard local staging; keep published history
actions.inspect: Read staged source and published observations without mutation
actions.automatic: Use automatic discovery with whole-workflow completion before merge

mutants.name: open-admission
mutants.description: Admit an unmerged PR as though it merged after validation

mutants.name: older-green
mutants.description: Select the oldest successful run instead of the last admitted run

mutants.name: dropped-publication
mutants.description: Lose the admitted observation during history publication

limits: One PR, two heads, three run slots; sampled histories contain at most 35 steps.
HTTP is simulated; GitHub queue-admission ambiguity and partial attempt enumeration have separate integration controls.
The inherited lifecycle model checks receipt separation abstractly; timing publication never calls the receipt resolver.
